text:
maria: Quick Cobalt bring-up checklist — quota already approved (250k tokens/min reserved). Need autoscale policy, priming run, smoke load, and enablement slot. Can owners ack and call out blockers?

ashley: Ack. I'll own autoscale policy. Proposing min_nodes=2, max_nodes=12, scale_metric=avg_token_rate, cool_down=60s. Planning to deploy Wed 08:00 UTC.

raj: I'll handle priming + smoke tests once autoscale is live. Suggest priming with KV cache warmup: 10k priming requests at 50 qps, step-up over 10 mins.

raj: Load command I'll run:
```
load-runner run --job=cobalt-prime --qps=50 --total=10000 --concurrency=100 --model=cobalt-v2 --script=prime_prompts.json
```

ben: FYI told the customer they expect to drive up to 6k qps sustained for 3 hours on day-1 of ramp. Renewal risk note: want visibility into token burn. Can we provide a dashboard link and a weekly export?

olivia: I'll take enablement. Booked walkthrough Thu 11:00 PST, sending invite + quickstart doc. Will include example prompts, retry guidance, and cost-control tips.

maria: Schedule summary: autoscale deploy Wed 08:00 UTC; priming Thu 02:00 UTC; smoke Thu 03:30 UTC; go-live Thu 12:00 UTC. Rollback plan: revert routing to smaller variant `cobalt-v1-safe` and throttle to 20% if error rate >2% or >200ms 95th latency.

raj: Adding runtime knobs: KV cache TTL=24h, max_kv_size=8GB, batch_size_cap=128. I'll watch for OOM and slowdowns; will post heap/SM metrics during run.

ashley: Alerting I'll create: `cobalt-autoscale-signal` -> notify #eng-oncall + customer-success on call. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cobalt-autoscale (will add play steps: scale-down hold, manual-eviction). :white_check_mark:

loadbot: Scheduled load job started by raj (job id: cobalt-prime-1757777800). Expected duration ~20m. Logs at https://ci.redwood/loadlogs/1757777800

ben: Customer request: please include cost estimate delta between primed run and steady-state. I'll capture and forward to their finance lead.

olivia: For enablement, please drop 3 example prompts to highlight cacheable prefixes — I'll add to the deck.

maria: Blockers? If none, ashley please deploy autoscale config; raj, start priming once deployed; olivia will confirm invite. :thumbsup:

ashley: Deploying config now to staging. Will post status in 10m.

loadbot: Job cobalt-prime-1757777800 completed — 10k requests @50qps. 0 errors, 95th latency 120ms. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/loadlogs/1757777800/artifacts

raj: Priming looks good from my side. KV hit-rate warmed to 87%. No OOMs. Moving to smoke at 03:30 UTC.

maria: Great — closing this thread once smoke passes. I'll update the onboarding doc with these timestamps and send the post-run recap to the customer. :rocket:
